newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Glasstech Inc sells $70 mln in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Glasstech Inc sells $70 mln in junk bonds.

text.p: The following 144A debt issue from Glasstech Inc was priced on Monday via lead manager CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Corp, according to market sources.
The deal was sold as units including warrants to purchase up to five percent of the company.
The company, based in Perrysburg, Ohio, produces bending and tempering systems used by glass manufacturers and processors in the conversion of flat glass into safety glass.
